subject: Order Form — invoice recipient, min-commit triggers, VAT assignment
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orionhealth.com>, Orion Health Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Order Form — invoice recipient, min-commit triggers, VAT assignment

Samantha / Procurement team,

Thanks for the call earlier. To finalize the Order Form and get the DocuSign out, we need confirmation on three commercial points so Finance and Legal can complete their redlines:

1) Invoice recipient: which legal entity should Redwood bill? Options:
   - Orion Health US, Inc. (preferred for USD invoicing)
   - Orion Health UK Ltd (if you need VAT on the invoice)

2) Minimum commit trigger: we propose activation billing kicks in when usage >10% of monthly commit for two consecutive months. If you prefer a different trigger (percent or time window), please confirm.

3) VAT / tax treatment: please confirm whether Orion plans to self-account (reverse charge) or requires Redwood to charge VAT. If you need us to charge VAT we will need a VAT registration number and country of tax residence.

Attached: pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx (token bands + proration examples). Once we have the above we can push the redline through Legal.

Next steps: please reply by EOD so we can include the answers in the redline and send to your procurement team.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
O: +1 415 555 0198
Attachments: pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orionhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Health Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2025-12-04T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — invoice recipient, min-commit triggers, VAT assignment

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks — quick answers:

1) Invoice recipient: Please bill to "Orion Health US, Inc." for this contract (we will route PO internally to the US accounting entity). Currency: USD.

2) Min commit trigger: 10% / two months seems reasonable, but procurement asks for a 30-day notice period before activation billing begins (so they can open a PO). Can Redwood accommodate a 30-day notice cliff before first invoice relating to commit activation?

3) VAT: We are US-headquartered for this business line; no VAT expected. If there are EU components later we'll raise with you. For now, self-accounting / reverse charge not applicable.

Attached our standard procurement form for reference.

Samantha Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager | Orion Health
samantha.lee@orionhealth.com
Attachments: Orion_Procurement_Form.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-04T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — invoice recipient, min-commit triggers, VAT assignment

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for the quick responses — looping in Legal and Finance. A few redline notes from our side (attached as Orion_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf):

- Invoice recipient: confirmed as "Redwood Inference, Inc." invoicing to Orion Health US, Inc.; Finance requests invoices be addressed exactly to the entity name shown on the PO.
- Notice period: we can accept a 30-day notice window before activation billing. We'll add a clause that allows us to invoice for activation if usage exceeds the threshold after the notice period and provide examples in the billing appendix.
- Min-commit trigger language: replace "two consecutive months" with "two consecutive billing periods (calendar months)" and add an explicit calculation example to avoid ambiguity.
- VAT/tax: since you're US-resident for this contract, we'll present invoices without VAT. If a VAT liability arises later, we'll add an appendix that addresses reverse-charge and the need for a VAT number; Redwood will not retroactively gross-up charges unless otherwise agreed.

Please review the attached redline and confirm. Also advise a PO number and expected PO issuance date so Finance can align invoice timing.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachments: Orion_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-12-04T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order Form — invoice recipient, min-commit triggers, VAT assignment

Samantha — thanks, all noted and appreciate the quick turnaround.

Summary / next steps:
1) Redwood will send the redline (attached) with the clarified "two consecutive billing periods" language and explicit example.
2) Finance will invoice Orion Health US, Inc. in USD, net 30 by default; please confirm if procurement needs Net 45 and we'll log as a commercial exception. If Net 45, confirm PO includes that term.
3) We will include an activation notice clause with a 30-day notice before the first activation invoice.
4) VAT: no action required now given US residency; if your tax stance changes we'll handle via appendix.

Please confirm the PO number and whether you need Net 45. Once confirmed I'll send the DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABCDEFG12345) and link this thread to HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-67890).

Cheers,
Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
